title: Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees Refund Rates: Cuts, Withdrawals, Injuries and Trip Cancellations
content:
When a student leaves an activity of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, the share credited and the windows that decide it are set per activity type as follows. Days are calendar days.

## Credit shares

| Activity type | Credited when cut at tryouts (share of the waivable fees net of waivers) | Withdrawal credit window (days after clearance, clearance date is day 0) | Credited for a withdrawal inside the window (share of the participation fee net of waivers) | Credited for a season-ending injury documented before the season midpoint (share of the participation fee net of waivers) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | 0 percent | 10 | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | 0 percent | 10 | 100 percent | 0 percent |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | 0 percent | 10 | 100 percent | 50 percent |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | 0 percent | 10 | 100 percent | 0 percent |
| High School UIL Athletics | 100 percent | 10 | 100 percent | 50 percent |
| Cheer and Dance Team | 100 percent | 10 | 100 percent | 50 percent |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | 0 percent | 10 | 0 percent | 0 percent |

## Trip dates

| Activity type | Days before departure by which the trip balance must be settled | Days before departure up to which a cancellation credits the trip deposit |
|---|---|---|
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | 21 | 30 |
| every other type | 0 | 0 |

A 0 in the trip columns means the type is not a trip.

## Reading the shares (hypothetical amounts)

- A hypothetical participation fee net of waivers of 62.40 on a Middle School UIL Athletics participation gives an injury credit at 50 percent of 31.20, and a withdrawal credit inside the window at 100 percent of 62.40.
- The same events on a Campus Club Membership participation credit 0 percent, that is nothing.
- For a Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip with a hypothetical departure on day 0, the trip balance is settled by day minus 21, and the deposit figure of 30 days places its window edge at day minus 30.
